title: OpenCode HTTP Lifecycle Orchestrator Skeleton
summary: The FP-MCP-254 OpenCode HTTP lifecycle orchestrator skeleton was implemented, exposed, and verified with a bounded canary lifecycle. The tool created one titled OpenCode session, submitted the canary prompt through /session/{id}/prompt_async, observed role-aware assistant completion through /session/{id}/message, and cleaned up the created session. Result: lifecycleRan=true, sessionCreated=true, promptAsyncSubmitted=true, assistantCompletionObserved=true, expectedTextObservedInAssistant=true, completionState=COMPLETED, cleanupAttempted=true, sessionDeleted=true, createHttpStatus=200, promptAsyncHttpStatus=204, finalMessagesHttpStatus=200, deleteHttpStatus=200, pollCount=6, assistantTextPaths=["[1].parts[2].text"], boundedAssistantTextExcerpts=["OPENCODE_HTTP_CANARY_OK"].
caveats: Verified only with a tiny canary prompt.
The observed assistant text path is an example shape, not a fixed index contract.
The tool uses role-aware assistant text scanning as the completion rule.
boundaries: No OpenCode process start by this tool.
Only the created canary session was cleaned up.
